library.name: HLK_fingerprint
library.author: GavinnnTann <gavin3302@gmail.com>
library.sentence: Arduino driver for HLK-ZW series fingerprint sensors (EF-01 UART protocol).
library.paragraph: Supports HLK-ZW101, ZW111, ZW06xx, ZW09xx, ZW30xx and other EF-01 compatible modules (AS608, R307). Features auto-detection of template capacity, 2-scan enrollment, 1:N matching with automatic search-opcode fallback for ZW30xx variants, template export/import, slot bitmap, RGB LED control with passive-variant fallback, and full system register access.
